# Editions

<!-- Generated from the engine code by `make docs`: do not edit by hand. -->

Hyprland decorations a joker may come with in the shop, for a higher price.
Blur and Shadow apply before the joker's own effect, Animated after it.

| Id | Name | Effect | Extra price | Shop odds | Quip |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `blur` | Blur | +50 chips | +$2 | 2% | *Looks expensive. Costs GPU.* |
| `shadow` | Shadow | +10 mult | +$3 | 1.4000000000000001% | *Depth, for your flat design.* |
| `animated` | Animated | ×1.5 mult | +$5 | 0.3% | *Wobbly windows are back.* |
| `transparent` | Transparent | +1 joker slot | +$5 | 0.3% | *See-through. Takes no room.* |
